prompt.text:
Implement `summarizeSelections(responses, allowedOptions)`.

`allowedOptions` must be an array of unique, non-empty strings. `responses` must be an array of objects with a non-empty string `respondent` and an array of string `choices`. Invalid structures must throw `TypeError`.

Within one response, count each allowed option at most once, even if repeated in `choices`. Ignore unknown choices. Repeated respondent names in different responses are separate responses and may appear repeatedly in output lists.

Return `{ totalResponses, options }`. `totalResponses` is the input length. Each option entry is `{ option, count, respondents }`; respondents preserve response order. Include allowed options with zero selections. Order option entries by descending count, then ascending option using JavaScript UTF-16 string ordering. Empty inputs are valid. Return only fresh arrays and objects and do not mutate either input. Export exactly `{ summarizeSelections }` using CommonJS.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
